WITH 
-- SCE from scanpointcloud (via scans for zoneref)
sce AS (
    SELECT s.zoneref,
        AVG(sp.coverpct * (1 + sp.lappct/100.0 * (1 - sp.coverpct/100.0))) as sce_val
    FROM scans s
    JOIN scanpointcloud sp ON s.arcref = sp.arcref
    GROUP BY s.zoneref
),
-- SQS components from scanpointcloud (via scans)
sqs_data AS (
    SELECT s.zoneref,
        AVG((10.0 / (log(sp.scanresolmm * 1000.0) / log(sp.pointdense) * 5.0)) ^ 1.5 * (sp.coverpct / 100.0) * power(1 - sp.noisedb / 30.0, 2)) as sqs_val,
        AVG(sp.noisedb) as noise_val,
        AVG(sp.scanresolmm) as scanresolmm_val
    FROM scans s
    JOIN scanpointcloud sp ON s.arcref = sp.arcref
    GROUP BY s.zoneref
),
-- RAR from scanregistration (via scans)
rar AS (
    SELECT s.zoneref,
        AVG(sp.scanresolmm / (sr.logaccumm * sqrt(1 + sr.errvalmm / sr.logaccumm))) as rar_val,
        AVG(sr.errvalmm) as errvalmm_val
    FROM scans s
    JOIN scanregistration sr ON s.arcref = sr.arcref
    JOIN scanpointcloud sp ON s.arcref = sp.arcref
    GROUP BY s.zoneref
),
-- MCR, TDI, GeomDelta from scanmesh (has zoneref directly)
mcr_tdi AS (
    SELECT sm.zoneref,
        AVG(sm.facetfaces / (sm.facetverts * sm.facetresmm * sm.facetresmm) * 1000.0) as mcr_val,
        AVG(sm.texpix / (sqrt(sm.facetfaces) * sm.facetresmm) * 0.01) as tdi_val,
        AVG(sm.geomdeltamm) as geomdelta_val
    FROM scanmesh sm
    GROUP BY sm.zoneref
),
-- All zones from sites
all_zones AS (
    SELECT zoneregistry FROM sites
),
-- Combine all metrics
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        az.zoneregistry as zoneref,
        COALESCE(s.sce_val, 0) as sce_val,
        COALESCE(sq.sqs_val, 0) as sqs_val,
        COALESCE(sq.noise_val, 0) as noise_val,
        COALESCE(sq.scanresolmm_val, 1) as scanresolmm_val,
        COALESCE(r.rar_val, 0) as rar_val,
        COALESCE(r.errvalmm_val, 0) as errvalmm_val,
        COALESCE(m.mcr_val, 0) as mcr_val,
        COALESCE(m.tdi_val, 0) as tdi_val,
        COALESCE(m.geomdelta_val, 0) as geomdelta_val
    FROM all_zones az
    LEFT JOIN sce s ON az.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
    LEFT JOIN sqs_data sq ON az.zoneregistry = sq.zoneref
    LEFT JOIN rar r ON az.zoneregistry = r.zoneref
    LEFT JOIN mcr_tdi m ON az.zoneregistry = m.zoneref
),
-- Compute derived metrics
with_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        zoneref,
        -- MFS = MCR × (TDI/10) × (1 + exp(-GeomDeltaMm))
        mcr_val * (tdi_val / 10.0) * (1 + exp(-geomdelta_val)) as mfs_val,
        sce_val, rar_val, sqs_val, noise_val, errvalmm_val, scanresolmm_val
    FROM combined
),
-- Compute ADC and final DPQ
final_dpq AS (
    SELECT 
        wm.zoneref,
        ROUND(CAST((
            0.3 * (sq.sqs_val * 0.4 + wm.mfs_val * 0.4 + wm.sce_val * 0.2 - 5.0 * sqrt(wm.noise_val / 10.0))
            + 0.3 * wm.mfs_val
            + 0.2 * wm.rar_val
            + 0.2 * wm.sce_val
            - 2.0 * sqrt(wm.errvalmm_val / NULLIF(wm.scanresolmm_val, 0))
        ) AS numeric), 2) as dpq_value
    FROM with_metrics wm
    LEFT JOIN sqs_data sq ON wm.zoneref = sq.zoneref
)
SELECT 
    sd.zoneregistry as site_code,
    sd.zonelabel as site_name,
    fd.dpq_value as dpq
FROM final_dpq fd
JOIN sites sd ON fd.zoneref = sd.zoneregistry
ORDER BY fd.dpq_value DESC;
